title: Senior Data Scientist → Associate Director, Technical Lead for Protein Discovery

variants.compbio: Led the supervised-learning strategy for protein optimization: protein-language-model embeddings with supervised fitness heads, plus active learning and Bayesian optimization to select each design-build-test round's variant library, surfacing variants with up to a 1.5X increase in activity.
variants.tech: Led the modeling behind our protein-design program: represented each candidate protein with embeddings from a pretrained protein language model, trained models on those to predict how well each would perform, and used the predictions to choose which few to test each round given limited experimental resources. Improved activity by up to 1.5x in the best designs.
variants.llm-product: Led modeling and experimental design for our protein-design program: language-model embeddings, supervised models to predict performance, and active learning to choose which few candidates to test each round under a fixed budget. Improved activity by up to 1.5x.

variants.tech: Built and labeled the training data and trained an XGBoost classifier on nucleotide embeddings from Evo2 (a genomic language model), sorting genomic sequence into categories at over 90% accuracy and more than doubling how much of our data we could annotate automatically.
variants.llm-product: Built and labeled training data and trained an XGBoost classifier on foundation-model (Evo2) embeddings: over 90% accuracy, more than doubling the data we could annotate automatically.
